core_problem_solved: To define a superset of the standard StAX (Streaming API for XML, JSR-173) API, adding new features for improved performance, validation, and usability that were found to be missing from the original specification.
key_features: Defines additional API interfaces for typed access (e.g., reading numbers directly)
Adds capabilities for DTD and schema validation against the stream
This artifact contains only the API interfaces, not the implementation.
era_and_niche: A specialized API for high-performance XML parsing in Java. It is the official API for the Woodstox StAX implementation, one of the fastest XML parsers available for Java.
reason_for_obsolescence: This API is **not obsolete**. It is a core part of the Woodstox XML parser, which is still a state-of-the-art, high-performance StAX implementation. It is used in scenarios that require faster XML processing than what the default JDK parser (part of JAXP) provides.
